If a payment method still isn't on the account, that is the only thing that matters this morning. Second, the Lead-Gen campaign still reads PAUSED in yesterday's 8 AM refresh (Jul 7), meaning roughly five straight days of idle ad budget and zero new $17 leads entering the pipeline. Inbox has no prospect replies again, so working existing leads and manual outbound is the entire revenue motion today.
focus: GHL trial ends July 10 — that's two days out. If billing still isn't attached, add a payment method to GHL before anything else today. A lapse deletes the pipeline, all 27+ leads, A2P registration, and all three workflows in one shot. Nothing else on the board comes close in stakes.

The Lead-Gen campaign still showed PAUSED in yesterday's refresh — that's about five days at ~$35/day of budget doing nothing and no new $17 leads. Open Ads Manager and either relaunch it or confirm the pause is intentional, then decide today whether that $35/day is better spent on outbound.

Inbox is clear of prospect replies again, so outbound is the only motion that creates revenue. Text every unbooked GHL lead a direct booking link this afternoon and reply to every comment on today's 9 AM FB group post within the hour while it's warm.
